mapper.sql: tdm10_task_id AS task_id , tdm10_task_class_cd AS task_class_code , f_cdnm('TdmTaskClassCode', tdm10_task_class_cd, tdm10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS task_class_name , tdm10_task_type_cd AS task_type_code , '('||tdm14_task_type_cd||')'||tdm14_task_type_nm AS task_type_name , tdm10_task_nm AS task_name , tdm10_common_yn AS common_yn , tdm10_ceo_yn AS ceo_yn , tdm10_start_date AS start_date , tdm10_end_date AS end_date , tdm10_upd_nm AS upd_name , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tdm10_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS upd_date_str , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '' ELSE COUNT(*)||'건' END FROM tdm12_task_relate_detail WHERE tdm12_task_id = tdm10_task_id ) AS task_relate_detail_cnt_str , COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm11_task_relate_rule WHERE tdm11_task_id = tdm10_task_id AND tdm11_relate_type = '1' ),0) AS task_relate_law_cnt , COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm11_task_relate_rule WHERE tdm11_task_id = tdm10_task_id AND tdm11_relate_type = '2' ),0) AS task_relate_rule_cnt
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM tdm10_task INNER JOIN tdm14_task_type ON tdm10_company_id = tdm14_company_id AND tdm14_task_type_cd = tdm10_task_type_cd WHERE tdm10_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm10_task_class_cd LIKE #{taskClassCode} AND CONCAT(tdm14_task_type_cd, tdm14_task_type_nm, tdm10_task_nm) ILIKE #{searchText}
AND CAST(#{baseDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date, TO_DATE('29991231','yyyyMMdd'))
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm21_role_relate_task INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm21_role_id WHERE tdm20_company_id = #{companyId} AND CAST(#{baseDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm20_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm20_end_date, TO_DATE('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) AND tdm21_task_id = tdm10_task_id AND COALESCE(tdm10_common_yn,'false') != 'true' )
ORDER BY tdm10_task_type_cd, tdm10_task_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm10_task ( tdm10_task_id, tdm10_company_id, tdm10_task_class_cd, tdm10_task_type_cd, tdm10_task_nm , tdm10_common_yn, tdm10_ceo_yn, tdm10_start_date, tdm10_end_date, tdm10_upd_nm, tdm10_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{companyId}, #{req.taskClassCode}, #{req.taskTypeCode}, #{req.taskName} , #{req.commonYn}, #{req.ceoYn}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.endDate}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
